title: Shops and Places in Town
description: Practice Shops and Places in Town.

questions.question: Where do you buy stamps and send letters?
questions.explanation: You buy stamps and send letters at the post office.

questions.question: Where do you buy medicine?
questions.explanation: Medicine is bought at a pharmacy.

questions.question: How do you ask where a place is?
questions.explanation: 'Where is the bank?' is the standard question form.

questions.question: "I need money, so I'm going to the bank." Why is the speaker going to the bank?
questions.explanation: They need money, so they go to the bank to get it.
